name: Portugal
dossier:
The Portugal national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the A Seleção, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 6 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A legend's last World Cup, surrounded by a frighteningly talented supporting cast.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Portugal will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group K and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group K. The connection between Cristiano Ronaldo and Bruno Fernandes is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Cristiano Ronaldo - the clinical forward who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Portugal are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Cristiano Ronaldo is the only player to score in five different World Cups  -  this is the final chapter.
Portugal boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Third place (1966).
